scope: Shared CPU int64/uint64 tensor captures/results, mixed numeric task packets, retained immutable ownership and local worker failure settlement.

semantics.identity: Integer tensor task keys derive their numeric name and rank; IDs extend the existing per-element/per-rank integer namespace to int64/uint64. Float32 and 32-bit integer identities remain unchanged. Task handles keep their shared handle key.
semantics.storage: Existing opaque-pointer descriptors, checked eight-byte CPU kernels, retained tensor copy callbacks and common continuation planner; no scheduler/runtime/storage implementation changes.
semantics.packets: All five supported tensor families plus signed/unsigned64 scalars in one packet. Each tensor family returned as root. INT64_MIN/UINT64_MAX scalar offsets are checked against their full-range constants to detect capture truncation; exact tensor endpoints and above-2^53 cells survive.
semantics.lifetime: Nested captures, handle aliases and repeated awaits retain immutable tensor backing. Cached host observation and RetainedCpuTensor leases survive worker pool, task outcome and destination Invocation destruction. Opposite signedness IDs with identical bytes/callbacks cannot publish or retain a result.
semantics.failure: Arithmetic and shape faults carry no successful tensor payload and retain source locations. Recovery can reuse parent data and launch a new group. Root cancellation/deadline/admission signals and allocation injection positions 1..24 settle all scheduler and allocation counters.
semantics.remaining: 64-bit reductions/matmul still rejected in frontend and backend, including task-containing source. Metal integer arithmetic, further formats/conversions and public foreign-memory/wire ABI remain unqualified.

coverage: One mixed fixture containing int64/uint64/int32/uint32/float32 tensors and both 64-bit scalar families; all five root tensor types
Ranks zero through three, exact 64-bit literals, empty tensor division, nested groups, aliased handles and repeated awaits
Exact result ABI bytes/alignment and per-element/per-rank IDs, mismatched same-size signedness layout leaves output bytes untouched and retains no owners
Retained cells remain valid after task core/worker/destination invocation destruction; scheduler counters and invocation allocations/releases settle
Addition/subtraction/multiplication overflow, unsigned underflow, zero division/remainder, signed-minimum division/negation and unsigned negation
Arithmetic recovery with unchanged parent tensor and a fresh group; shape refinement failure with no payload
Root cancellation/deadline/admission signals, allocation rejection positions 1..24 with 1/2/4 workers
Shared frontend task typing under independent ASan/UBSan; prior synchronous tensor suites now accept worker handoff
Reduction/matmul diagnostics preserve prior artifacts; Metal integer arithmetic remains rejected
qualification.gpu_shader_sanitizers: Host ASan/UBSan and TSan do not instrument Metal shaders.

performance: No performance claim or benchmark in this milestone.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design discussion remains a prerequisite.
